mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, persistent inflation triggers aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in UNRATE signals a recessionary monetary policy response to labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in PAYEMS signals worsening labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with rising HOUST, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index base 2017=100), it indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary demand regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 0.5%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals deteriorating consumer spending that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with GDPC1 annualized growth < 0.5% and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic contraction across manufacturing and residential sectors, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with INDPRO and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
